title: CollateralGuard Plan Schedule — Value Bands, Premiums and Placed Coverage Terms
content:
Collateral Protection Insurance is written in six plans, CollateralGuard Plan A through CollateralGuard Plan F, each covering one band of vehicle value. The band a vehicle's value falls in decides the plan, and the plan fixes the figures below.

## Value bands

| Plan | Vehicle value from (USD) | Vehicle value through (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| CollateralGuard Plan A | 0.00 | 7500.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan B | 7500.01 | 12500.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan C | 12500.01 | 18000.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan D | 18000.01 | 25000.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan E | 25000.01 | 35000.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan F | 35000.01 | 50000.00 |

The valuation used to place a record in a band is the NADA clean trade-in value on the placement date. The band is reassessed at renewal, 12 months after placement, in every plan.

## Placed coverage figures by plan

| Plan | Monthly premium (USD) | Deductible on a claim under placed coverage (USD) | Maximum claim payment (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| CollateralGuard Plan A | 58.40 | 500.00 | 7500.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan B | 79.85 | 500.00 | 12500.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan C | 103.20 | 750.00 | 18000.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan D | 131.75 | 750.00 | 25000.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan E | 168.90 | 1000.00 | 35000.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan F | 214.60 | 1000.00 | 50000.00 |

The monthly premium is the premium for each monthly billing period of placed coverage. A claim under placed coverage pays the lesser of the vehicle's actual cash value, the contract payoff and the plan's maximum claim payment.

## Terms common to every plan (A through F)

| Term | Value in each of Plans A, B, C, D, E and F |
|---|---|
| Coverage the company places | single-interest physical damage coverage |
| Whether placed coverage includes liability or any protection for the borrower | no |
| Term of one placement before renewal | 12 months |
| Whether a renewal of placed coverage requires a new first and second notice | no |
| Valuation used to place a record in a plan band | NADA clean trade-in value on the placement date |
| Months after placement at which the band is reassessed at renewal | 12 |
| Fee charged for insurance tracking | USD 0.00 |
| Tracking records open (not closed) at once for one contract | 1 |

## Reading the schedule

**Which plan does a vehicle valued at exactly USD 12500.00 fall in?** CollateralGuard Plan B, whose band runs through 12500.00; a value of 12500.01 falls in CollateralGuard Plan C.

**Hypothetical:** a vehicle valued at USD 30000.00 on the placement date falls in CollateralGuard Plan E, so placed coverage bills USD 168.90 for each monthly period, carries a USD 1000.00 claim deductible and pays at most USD 35000.00 on a claim.
